headline: Record operating results but net income and EPS drop sharply
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1,905.2B (+4.3% y/y) and operating profit KRW 530.1B (+13.9% y/y); EPS was KRW 1,022, down 73.8% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 1,022 fell 70.9% q/q and 73.8% y/y. Reports put consolidated revenue at KRW 1,905.2B and operating profit at KRW 530.1B, both quarterly records. Cigarette operating profit was KRW 425.5B and health foods KRW 80.1B. Net income was reported near KRW 104B, down 75.1%. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from Korea Times, Herald and wire reposts. The gap between record operating profit and sharply lower net income was not explained in the sources found. EPS is Yahoo data.
